subject: [hw] J04 addendum: vendor libjpeg property name ro.vendor.jpeg_decode_sw_opt + C-model strings
body:
Two printable-string facts for the vendor section of FACTS.md (read at run time from gpu/build/cam-vendor-20261109/vfs, nothing copied):

[V] The 32-bit AND 64-bit `libjpeg-alpha-oal_vendor.so` contain the property name `ro.vendor.jpeg_decode_sw_opt` and use `__system_property_get`; the same library prints `[INFO] Hybrid-JPGDEC: by property`. So the OAL selects the hybrid JPEG-decode path (and/or a software path) from that system property. What value means what is [I]; it is the knob a host fake `__system_property_get` should sweep when capturing the 21 words.

[V] The 32-bit AND 64-bit `libjpeg-alpha_vendor.so` print `[INFO] Hybrid-JPGDEC HW C-model: disabled` plus `[Hybrid] Wait IRQ ...`, `[HYBRID] Read progress n status failed (%d)`, `[HYBRID] jpeg_hy_set_src buffer size is not alignment (%d)`. That is direct evidence that the vendor library contains a software model of the hybrid block and a tile/IRQ path; with the fake OAL the C-model may compute the words with no hardware. No code or disassembly was inspected, strings only.
